THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondents/State.

2. This petition is filed by the petitioner seeking a writ of mandamus and for a direction to the respondents to consider the representations of the petitioner dated 11.04.2016 and 03.09.2016 which are produced at Annexures-F and G.
3.
The petitioner is the land-loser by virtue of a notification under Sections 4(1) and 6(1) of the Land Acquisition Act. 1984.
The respondents have acquired the land of petitioner for formation of road from Bagdal to Ramtirth Wadi via Bairnalli, Bidar.

The respondents passed NC: 2023:KHC-K:9233 a preliminary award of compensation dated 24.07.2015 under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, 'the Act of 2013').

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Preliminary Award came to be passed on 18.08.2015 with regard to the land of petitioner measuring 07 acres 02 guntas situated at Sirsi Village, Taluk and District Bidar.
The total extent of land acquired to that of the petitioner to an extent of one acre.

4. It is the grievance of the petitioner that award has not been determined and no suitable compensation has been paid, for which the petitioner given a representation on 11.04.2016 and again on 03.09.2016 to the respondents-authorities to reconsider and pass suitable compensation in Bhojappa S/O Sabanna Malag vs Deputy Commissioner And Anr on 14 December, 2023

entities.label: PRECEDENT

2 accordance with law and rectify the errors.
This representation has not been considered and no action has been taken by the respondents for making a reference for adjudication of the matter in accordance with law.
Hence, petitioner is before this Court.
Learned High Court Government Pleader representing the respondents/State contends that the petitioner has not approached the authority within the time prescribed under the Act of 2013.

Therefore, this petition is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed.
6.
I have perused the petition papers and the provisions of Section 64 of the Act of 2013.

No doubt,
30 days is provided for making a reference to the appropriate authority as per Section 64(1) of proviso, but as per Section 64(2) of proviso, there is no bar for the petitioner to make an application after a period of thirty days and if such an application is made before the authority, it could be considered under Section 64(2) of proviso (1) and (2) of the Act of 2013.
7. The present petition is filed only to consider the representation made by the petitioner.
Admittedly the petitioner is the land loser and land of the petitioner has been acquired which is not dispute.

Under the circumstances, the authorities are duty bound to consider NC:
2023:KHC-K:9233 the representation and pass suitable orders.

Accordingly, I pass the following :
ORDER (i) The petition is allowed.

(ii) Writ of mandamus is issued to respondents to consider the representations of petitioner dated 11.04.2016 and 03.09.2016 and pass suitable orders in accordance with law within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Sd/-
